name: doki-wallpaper-carousel
description: Unofficial companion for the Doki Theme: flip your animated wallpaper through a folder of GIFs, show it behind the side bars, panel and terminal, and turn .mp4 videos into GIF wallpapers.

dokiCarousel.folder.description: Folder containing the GIFs/images to cycle through.

dokiCarousel.includeSubfolders.description: Also look for images inside subfolders.

dokiCarousel.extensions.description: File extensions included in the carousel.

dokiCarousel.sortBy.description: How files in the folder are ordered.

enumDescriptions: Change doki.wallpaper.path (glass pane over the code editor)
dokiCarousel.target.description: Which Doki setting the carousel changes.

enumDescriptions: Open the workspace in a new window and close the current one (needed: Reload Window keeps the old CSS cached)
Run 'Reload Window' (fast, but installed VS Code usually shows the cached old wallpaper)
Do nothing; restart VS Code yourself
dokiCarousel.reloadMode.description: How the window is refreshed once Doki has installed the new wallpaper.

dokiCarousel.maximize.description: Open the refreshed window maximized (reloadMode = newWindow).

dokiCarousel.fixTerminalText.description: Keep terminal text readable over the wallpaper by setting terminal.integrated.gpuAcceleration to "off" (Doki's wallpaper hides the GPU renderer's text).

dokiCarousel.transparentTerminal.description: Make terminal.background transparent (workbench.colorCustomizations) so the wallpaper shows behind the terminal text.

dokiCarousel.transparentPanels.description: Make sideBar.background, sideBarSectionHeader.background and panel.background transparent so the wallpaper shows in both side bars, the bottom panel and the terminal tabs list.

dokiCarousel.quickInputTint.description: Darkness (%) of the tint behind the command palette (Ctrl+Shift+P). 0 = fully transparent, 100 = solid black. Also adjustable with the slider in the Wallpaper Carousel panel.

dokiCarousel.brightenThumbnails.description: Brighten the hover previews of dimmed wallpapers (GIFs blended with a dark background), so they are easier to recognize. Only the previews change, never the GIFs.

dokiCarousel.showEditorTitleArrows.description: Show ← → arrows in the editor title bar.

dokiCarousel.showStatusBar.description: Show ◀ n/N ▶ controls in the status bar.

dokiCarousel.ffmpegPath.description: Folder containing ffmpeg and ffprobe (or the path to the ffmpeg executable). Empty = search the PATH and the usual install locations (Homebrew, apt, winget, scoop, ...).

dokiCarousel.converterScript.description: Optional: your own .ps1 converter taking the parameters of mp4_to_gif.ps1 (-Path, -Fps, -Width, ...). Runs with powershell.exe on Windows and pwsh (PowerShell 7) on macOS/Linux. Empty = built-in ffmpeg converter.
